description: Flat per-sample metadata schema for high-throughput sequencing of agricultural soil microbial communities across geographic regions and farming practices.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for each soil sequencing sample (e.g., field1_sampleA).

field_id.descr: Identifier linking multiple samples collected from the same agricultural field.

country.descr: Country where the field is located.

region.descr: Administrative or agroecological region within the country.

locality.descr: More specific place name or nearest locality to the sampling site.

latitude.descr: Latitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees (WGS84).

longitude.descr: Longitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees (WGS84).

elevation_m.descr: Elevation of the sampling location in meters above sea level.

sampling_date.descr: Date the soil sample was collected, in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

sampling_depth_cm.descr: Depth interval of soil collection in centimeters (e.g., 0-10).

crop_type.descr: Primary crop grown in the field at the time of sampling (e.g., wheat, maize, soybean).

cultivar_variety.descr: Crop cultivar or variety name, if known.

farming_practice.descr: Overall farming system classification (e.g., organic, conventional, regenerative, integrated).

management_practice_detail.descr: Additional description of agricultural management practices such as tillage, fertilization, irrigation, rotation, or pesticide use.

soil_type.descr: Soil classification name if available (e.g., sandy loam, clay loam, chernozem).

soil_texture.descr: Soil texture class measured or classified for the sample (e.g., sand, loam, clay, silt loam).

soil_ph.descr: Soil pH measured using the study's specified method.

soil_moisture_content.descr: Soil moisture content, reported as percentage (%) or fraction depending on study convention; units should be documented consistently.

soil_organic_matter.descr: Soil organic matter content, if measured, typically reported as percent (%).

soil_temperature_c.descr: Soil temperature at sampling in degrees Celsius.

bulk_density_g_cm3.descr: Soil bulk density in grams per cubic centimeter (g/cm^3), if measured.

nitrogen_available.descr: Available soil nitrogen concentration or index, with unit defined in accompanying study documentation.

phosphorus_available.descr: Available soil phosphorus concentration or index, with unit defined in accompanying study documentation.

potassium_available.descr: Available soil potassium concentration or index, with unit defined in accompanying study documentation.

irrigated.descr: Indicates whether the field was irrigated at or near the time of sampling (true/false).

previous_crop.descr: Crop grown in the previous season before the current crop, if known.

rotation_system.descr: Description of the crop rotation system used in the field, if applicable.

fertilizer_applied.descr: Indicates whether fertilizer was applied to the field before sampling (true/false).

fertilizer_type.descr: Type of fertilizer used (e.g., manure, synthetic NPK, compost), if applicable.

pesticide_applied.descr: Indicates whether pesticide or herbicide was applied before sampling (true/false).

yield_estimate.descr: Crop yield associated with the field or plot, reported in study-defined units such as t/ha when available.

yield_units.descr: Units for crop yield (e.g., t/ha, kg/plot).

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform used (e.g., Illumina MiSeq, NovaSeq).

target_marker.descr: Sequenced marker or assay type (e.g., 16S rRNA, ITS, shotgun metagenome).

replicate_number.descr: Technical or biological replicate number for the sample, if applicable.

sample_storage_condition.descr: Storage condition before DNA extraction (e.g., frozen at -80C, on ice, dried).

dna_extraction_method.descr: DNA extraction kit or protocol used for the sample.
